Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Rose Gold Dome Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture, 30"H, Copper Shade
Colors: Rose Gold
Materials: Metal
This metal dome-shaped pendant is modern yet finished with a warm rose gold tone to add a modern touch. Its design is simple and understated enough to blend with your existing style, whether classic or contemporary. Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended). Sleek design with an upscale flavor. Metal 12''Wx12''Dx30''H Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended) A simple accent light with warm finish for a kitchen or living room
